senses.gloss: (cmp. צבר, v. סַוָּאר) to pile, arrange.—Part. pass. סָווּר; f. סְווּרָה; pl. סְווּרוֹת.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Batra 3:6">Tosef. B. Bath. III, 6</cite> <he>העצים … האבנים ס׳ וכ׳</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>סוררות</he>, some ed. <he>סוירות</he>, corr. acc.) wood or stones piled up whether for his untilled field (for building) or for his fence; v. <cite ref="O00199"><he>סָדַר</he></cite> a. <cite ref="R00068"><he>צָבַר</he></cite>.
